value.rationale: The exact sharp b^2-1 palindrome cutoff, the two maximal factors, their complete occurrence sets and rational densities are a natural complete scale-dependent classification for a classical automatic family, not a renamed trivial bound or a numerical isolated case. It distinguishes base b>=3 from the unbounded base-two analogue and concretely informs hypotheses of general palindromic-length regularity studies.
